items.text:
I am recommending this game because currently (when I purchased it) it is on sale, and based on the previous game from this developer, I feel it will turn out to be a good game.  To purchase a good game early at a decent price with a good discount on top, means I have no regrets buying this game at this time.  

That being said, it has a lot of either bugs that stop your game, or balance adjustments needed to prevent your character reaching a point where you can no longer continue the current game.  How long will these changes take, unsure.

more info:
It's a 2d space ship control sim.  It has a bunch of realism in some parts of it (needing to consider the levels of various gases like oxygen, in your suit or ship when doing stuff)

But then a bit less realism in other parts (movement in space is on a flat two dimensional plane rather then three dimensions, and I have yet to experience any gravity forces at the moment, though momentum is portrayed.)

From what I can see so far, the main play loop or "goal" is to build up your personal ship by salvaging parts from other ships and interacting with npc(ai) characters with the idea you might hire them to your crew and then have to manage relationships with them as well as some of the work they do.

Once again, this game feels very early access at the moment.  I've supported a few other games, in similar states knowing I likely won't get the full experience I am hoping for out of the gates.  This is very much like that situation for me.  You can support it now, knowing you'll need to wait for bug fixes, balance fixes and additional content to be added to get the full experience, or you can wait till that is all added and see if the (possibly higher) price feels right for it at that time.

Personally, I see the direction for the game, and have prior work of the developer to look at to know they don't seem to be the type to grab money and leave you with an unfinished game at the end of it.  For those reasons, I feel comfortable both supporting and recommending others support this game.
items.text_zh:
我推荐这款游戏，因为目前（在我购买时）它正在打折，而且基于这位开发者之前的游戏，我觉得它最终会是一款好游戏。以合理的价格提前购买一款好游戏，再加上不错的折扣，意味着我此时购买这款游戏毫无遗憾。

话虽如此，它有很多要么会中止你游戏的bug，要么需要进行平衡调整，以防止你的角色达到无法继续当前游戏的地步。这些改动需要多长时间，不确定。

更多信息：
这是一款2D飞船操控模拟游戏。它在某些方面有很多真实感（在做事情时需要考虑你宇航服或飞船中各种气体如氧气的水平）

但在其他方面又少了一些真实感（太空中的移动是在平坦的二维平面上，而不是三维，而且我目前还没有体验到任何引力作用，尽管动量有所体现。）

据我目前所见，主要的游玩循环或“目标”是通过从其他飞船上打捞零件来建造你的个人飞船，并与NPC（AI）角色互动，想法是你可能会雇佣他们加入你的船员，然后必须管理与他们的关系以及他们所做的一些工作。

再次强调，这款游戏目前感觉非常处于抢先体验阶段。我曾支持过几款处于类似状态的其他游戏，知道自己很可能不会一开始就获得所期望的完整体验。对我来说，这非常像那种情况。你可以现在支持它，知道自己需要等待bug修复、平衡修复和额外内容的添加才能获得完整体验，或者你可以等到所有这些都添加完毕，再看看那时（可能更高的）价格是否合适。

就个人而言，我看到了这款游戏的方向，并且有开发者之前的作品可以参考，知道他们似乎不是那种捞一笔钱然后留给你一个未完成游戏的人。出于这些原因，我既乐于支持这款游戏，也乐于推荐其他人支持它。
